name: Aria2-Pro
description: Aria2 Pro | A perfect Aria2 Docker image.

variables.name: User UID
variables.description: Bind UID to the container, which means you can use a non-root user to manage downloaded files.

variables.name: User GID
variables.description: Bind GID to the container, which means you can use a non-root user to manage downloaded files.

variables.name: Aria2 BT/DHT Listen Port(aria2.conf)
variables.description: Set TCP/UDP port number for BitTorrent downloads. Multiple ports can be specified by using, for example: 6881,6885. You can also use - to specify a range: 6881-6999. , and - can be used together: 6881-6889,6999.

variables.name: Umask Setting
variables.description: For umask setting of Aria2, optional , default if left unset is 022

variables.name: Enable IPv6 Mode
variables.description: Whether to enable IPv6 support for Aria2. Optional: true | false. Set the options 'disable-ipv6=false' and 'enable-dht6=true' in the configuration file(aria2.conf).

variables.name: Aria2 Disk Cache(aria2.conf)
variables.description: Set up disk cache. SIZE can include K or M (1K = 1024, 1M = 1024K), e.g 64M.

variables.name: Update BT Trackers List
variables.description: Whether to update BT Trackers List automatically. Optional: true | flase, default if left unset is true

variables.name: BT Trackers List URL
variables.description: Custom BT Trackers List URL. If not set, get from https://trackerslist.com/all_aria2.txt.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Specify a timezone to use e.g. Asia/Shanghai
